I am an old man now, 78 years, but this maize plot is small and I know it well. Here in Iringa the rains come good most years, so maize grows if you help it — I will buy one small bag of CAN or DAP at the market, top-dress at weeding time, because without fertilizer the yield is poor even on our soils. I keep seed from last harvest, the local kind that I trust with my bean intercrop, and I put manure from the few animals we keep. My body is tired so I will pay two young men from the village for a few days at weeding, and my family will do the rest.
